audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows disagree with their own whys. Row 0 is Karma while its why says 'this stage is on your skill, not a free kill'; rows 1-2 are Skill/Malphite while their whys say you out-range him hard and shove him off the wave; row 3 is Malphite while its why says 'not a clear owner'; row 4 is Karma while its why says his R deletes you.
audit.why: Also confirmed from the other side: the malphite__karma audit explicitly concluded 'Level 6 should read Malphite'. The packet chart agrees row for row: Skill, Karma, Karma, Skill, Malphite, Malphite, Malphite.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Karma, Karma, Skill, Malphite, Malphite, Malphite in both layers, ratings re-scaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 why was boilerplate ('No new ultimate at 6') and never named Unstoppable Force or gave its numbers, in the one matchup where that ability IS the verdict.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s at 1000 range and knocks up — it is the engage neither Inspire nor Focused Resolve can answer.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the 130s cooldown and 1000 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Granite Shield's 10%-max-HP absorb, Thunderclap's auto-reset and on-hit application, and Seismic Shard's move-speed STEAL are all absent or vague.
audit.why: P recharges a 10% max-HP shield when he goes unhit for a few seconds — poke that lands only into the shield is wasted. W is autoReset + onHit, so his burst tell is an attack wind-up. Q is 8s flat and steals 3 seconds of your move speed, which is what makes his walk-ups land.
audit.corrected: Granite Shield added to the Don'ts, Seismic Shard's 8s / 3s steal to the Do's, and Thunderclap + Ground Slam mechanics to the interactions row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls this a 'Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10' with a green tone, while the win rate is 37.14% and diff already reads HARD.
audit.why: 37.14% over 70 games is the worst figure in this slice; the rating line contradicts both the win rate and the diff token on the same page.
audit.corrected: diffRating 8/10, carryRating 8/10, tone flipped to the hard-matchup red, and both copies of the rating sentence rewritten.

notes: The packet's suspectName 'His Unstoppable Force' is a false positive — the possessive pronoun tripped the matcher. The tldr ('Free poke forever — he farms at half HP'), winCon and breakdown.early/mid/carry are all written as if this were a favoured lane, which does not survive a 37.14% win rate or the page's own late block ('This is where the HARD verdict bites'). I fixed the rating line and tone; the optimistic tldr/winCon prose still needs a rewrite pass. Mirror malphite__karma is audited and its finding on level 6 is honoured here.
